thread.title: Man to Plead Guilty in Boulder Firebomb Attack
thread.title_full: Man to Plead Guilty in Boulder Firebomb Attack

author: MEAD GRUVER - Associated Press
title: Man to Plead Guilty in Boulder Firebomb Attack
text:
• Mohamed Sabry Soliman is scheduled to plead guilty to murder and other charges in a firebomb attack in Boulder, Colorado.
• The attack occurred during a demonstration in support of Israeli hostages in Gaza on June 1 of the previous year.
• Soliman faces a potential life sentence without parole.
• The attack resulted in one death and a dozen injuries.
• Soliman is accused of setting the fire.
• Soliman allegedly targeted a group of pro-Israel demonstrators.
• Soliman was arrested in the United States.
• Soliman is a Jordanian citizen.
• The fire caused significant damage.
• Authorities believe the attack was intentional.
• Soliman's defense has not commented on the case.
• The prosecution is seeking a life sentence.
• Soliman has been held in custody since the attack.
• The motive for the attack is still under investigation.
summary: BOULDER, Colo. (AP) — A man accused of a firebomb attack that killed one person and injured a dozen others during a demonstration last year in Boulder, Colorado, in support of Israeli hostages in Gaza was scheduled to plead guilty Thursday to murder and other charges.
